hebrewText: וְ/נָקַ֥ל זֹ֖את בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/נָתַ֥ן אֶת מוֹאָ֖ב בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶֽם

hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God

tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"
